history.@clearUndone: toast after undoing the emptying of selected table cells (Delete key); {count} is how many cells were emptied
history.@clearRedone: toast after redoing the emptying of selected table cells; {count} is how many cells were emptied
history.@fillDownUndone: toast after undoing a fill down (Ctrl+D copies the top cell of a selection into the cells below it)
history.@fillDownRedone: toast after redoing a fill down (the top cell copied into the cells below it)
history.@pasteUndone: toast after undoing a paste into table cells
history.@pasteRedone: toast after redoing a paste into table cells
history.@setManyUndone: toast after undoing a property set on several picked rows at once; {name} is the property's name (Status, Due), {count} is how many rows
history.@setManyRedone: toast after redoing a property set on several picked rows at once; {name} is the property's name (Status, Due), {count} is how many rows

@addedRows: toast after pasting more lines than the table had rows below the selection: the extra lines became new rows; {count} is how many

row.@dragToMove: screen-reader name of the grip at the start of a table row, dragged to move the row
row.@select: screen-reader name of the round checkbox at the start of a table row that picks it for bulk actions
row.@showSubItems: screen-reader name of the arrow beside a row that has sub-items (rows nested under it), when they're folded away
row.@hideSubItems: screen-reader name of the same arrow when the sub-items are showing
row.@subItemCount: tooltip of that arrow; {count} is how many rows are nested under this row
row.@addSubItem: button on a row's title cell that adds a row nested under it
row.@openAsPage: tooltip of the Open button on a row's title cell: every row is also a page

selection.@count: bar above the table while rows are picked; {count} is how many rows are picked
selection.@setProperty: button in that bar: picks a property, then gives every picked row the same value
selection.@clear: screen-reader name of the × button in that bar, which unpicks every row
selection.@selectAll: screen-reader name of the round checkbox in the table's header row

freeze.@frozen: tooltip of the pin beside the last frozen column's name: the columns up to it stay put while the table scrolls sideways
freeze.@frozenOverflow: the same tooltip when those columns are together wider than the window
freeze.noLongerFits: Frozen columns no longer fit in this window.
freeze.@noLongerFits: notice above the table when the frozen columns are wider than the window
freeze.@unfreeze: button beside that notice that stops freezing the columns (a verb)

@addProperty: the + button at the end of the table's header row (a property is a column), and the menu of column types it opens
@rows: screen-reader name of the table's grid of rows and cells

group.@show: screen-reader name of the arrow on a folded group heading in a grouped table
group.@hide: screen-reader name of the same arrow when the group is open
group.@newRowIn: screen-reader name of the + button on a group heading; {group} is the group's name (an option like Done, a month, or “No Status”)
group.@newRowHere: tooltip of the + button on a group heading, which adds a row to that group

empty.@noMatches: shown in a table whose rows are all hidden by the view's filters or search
empty.noRows: No rows yet. Click New, or paste rows from a spreadsheet.
empty.@noRows: shown in a table with no rows at all; New is the name of the New button (the same word as that button)

@calculate: shown on hover under a table column: click to pick a sum, count or average for the column (a verb)

header.@openFullPage: tooltip of a database's name shown above it inside another page
header.@changeIcon: tooltip of a database's icon, which opens the icon picker
header.@addIcon: button above a database's title that gives it an icon
header.@addDescription: placeholder of the empty line under a database's title, where a description can be written

@viewTabs: screen-reader name of a database's row of view tabs (Table, Board, Calendar…)
@addView: the + button after a database's view tabs, and the heading of the menu of layouts it opens

tabMenu.@settings: right-click menu of a view tab: opens that view's settings (layout, grouping, properties)
tabMenu.@moveLeft: right-click menu of a view tab: moves the tab one place to the left
tabMenu.@moveRight: right-click menu of a view tab: moves the tab one place to the right

@deleteView: command in a view tab's right-click menu and in the view's settings that deletes the view (its rows stay)
@viewSettings: tooltip of the current view's tab and screen-reader name of the sliders button: both open the view's settings

toolbar.@searchRows: placeholder of the search field above a database, and tooltip of the magnifier button that shows it
toolbar.@search: screen-reader name of the magnifier button above a database that shows a field to search its rows (a verb)
toolbar.@filter: button above a database that opens its filters (a verb)
toolbar.@sort: button above a database that opens its sorting (a verb)
toolbar.@automations: button above a database that opens its automations (rules that act when a row changes)
toolbar.@automationsOn: tooltip of that button when some automations are switched on; {count} is how many
toolbar.@settingsTip: tooltip of the sliders button above a database, which opens the view's settings
toolbar.@templates: screen-reader name of the arrow beside the New button, which opens the database's row templates
toolbar.@templateCount: tooltip of that arrow when the database has row templates; {count} is how many

@shownOfTotal: beside the filter chips above a database: how many rows the filters and search leave, out of all of them; {shown} is the rows left, {count} is the database's total rows (it picks the form)
@clearFilters: button at the end of the row of filter and sort chips above a database: removes every filter and sort and empties the search (a verb)
@loadingRows: shown while a large database's rows are read for the first time
dropCsv: Drop a CSV to add its rows
@dropCsv: shown over a database while a spreadsheet file is dragged onto it

panel.@filter: screen-reader name of the popover that holds a database's filters
panel.@sort: screen-reader name of the popover that holds a database's sorting
panel.@settings: screen-reader name of the popover that holds a view's settings
panel.@templates: screen-reader name of the popover that lists a database's row templates
panel.@automations: screen-reader name of the popover that lists a database's automations

layoutHint.@table: tooltip/hint of the Table layout of a database view
layoutHint.@board: tooltip of the Board layout in a view's settings
layoutHint.@gallery: tooltip of the Gallery layout in a view's settings
layoutHint.@list: tooltip of the List layout in a view's settings
layoutHint.@calendar: tooltip/hint of the Calendar layout of a database view
layoutHint.@chart: tooltip/hint of the Chart layout of a database view
layoutHint.@timeline: tooltip/hint of the Timeline layout of a database view
layoutHint.@form: tooltip/hint of the Form layout of a database view (a form that adds a row when filled in)

addViewHint.@board: hint beside Board in the Add a view menu
addViewHint.@gallery: hint beside Gallery in the Add a view menu
addViewHint.@list: hint beside List in the Add a view menu

view.name: View name
view.@name: screen-reader name of the field at the top of a view's settings that renames the view
view.@layout: heading over the layouts (Table, Board, Gallery…) in a view's settings
view.@columnsFrom: label in a board view's settings: the property whose options become the board's columns
view.@groupBy: label in a table or list view's settings: the property that groups the rows
view.@noGroup: choice under Group by: no grouping
view.@hideEmptyGroups: switch in a view's settings: groups with no rows aren't shown
view.@startsOn: label in a timeline view's settings: the date property where each bar starts
view.@showBy: label in a calendar view's settings: the date property rows are placed by
view.@endsOn: label in a timeline view's settings: the date property where each bar ends
view.@ownEndDate: choice under Ends on: the end of the start date's own range
view.@titleList: switch in a timeline view's settings: shows the rows' titles in a column beside the bars
view.@subItems: label in a view's settings: rows nested under other rows
view.@subItemsNested: choice under Sub-items: nested rows show under the row they belong to
view.@subItemsFlat: choice under Sub-items: nested rows show like any other row
view.@turnOnSubItems: button beside Sub-items that lets rows be nested under other rows
view.@turnOffSubItems: command in a view's settings that stops rows from being nested under others
view.@templateStart: label in a view's settings: the row template new rows are made from
view.@emptyRow: choice under New rows start from: no template
view.@untitledTemplate: name shown for a row template that has no title
view.@chart: label in a chart view's settings, beside the choice of chart type
view.@chartType: screen-reader name of the bar / donut / line choice
view.@chartDonut: chart type: a donut (ring-shaped pie) chart
view.@slices: label in a donut chart's settings: the property whose values become the slices
view.@alongBottom: label in a bar or line chart's settings: the property along the horizontal axis
view.@measure: label in a chart's settings: what the chart counts or adds up (a noun)
view.@countRows: choice under Measure: how many rows
view.@sumOf: choice under Measure; {name} is a number property's name (Price, Hours)
view.@averageOf: choice under Measure; {name} is a number property's name (Price, Hours)
view.@cardSize: label in a board or gallery view's settings
view.@sizeSmall: card size choice: small (one letter, or as short as your language allows)
view.@sizeMedium: card size choice: medium (one letter, or as short as your language allows)
view.@sizeLarge: card size choice: large (one letter, or as short as your language allows)
view.@cardPicture: label in a board or gallery view's settings: the picture shown on each card
view.@noPicture: choice under Card picture: no picture
view.@firstImage: choice under Card picture: the first image in the row's page
view.@wrap: switch in a table view's settings: long cell text goes onto more lines instead of being cut off
view.@columns: heading over a table view's properties, each of which can be shown or hidden
view.@onEachCard: heading over a card view's properties, each of which can be shown on the cards or not
view.@automatic: button beside On each card that goes back to showing whatever each row has filled in
view.automaticNote: Showing whatever each row has filled in. Pick properties to choose exactly.
view.@automaticNote: note under On each card while the cards choose their properties themselves
view.@exportCsv: command in a view's settings that saves the view's rows as a spreadsheet file
view.@opensInExcel: small hint after Export as CSV (lowercase, read as a continuation); Excel is the spreadsheet program
view.@duplicate: command in a view's settings that makes a copy of the view

newDatabase.title: New database
newDatabase.@title: heading of the window for starting a database (empty, from a template, or from a spreadsheet file)
newDatabase.lede: Rows you can sort, filter and see as a table, board, gallery, calendar or chart. Every row is a page too, with room for notes.
newDatabase.@importTitle: tile in that window that makes a database from a spreadsheet file
newDatabase.importText: A CSV from Excel, Google Sheets or Notion. Column types are worked out for you.
newDatabase.@importText: description on that tile; Excel, Google Sheets and Notion are product names
newDatabase.tip: Tip: paste rows from a spreadsheet straight into any table.

block.@deleted: shown in a page where a database block was, once the database is gone for good
block.@inTrash: shown in a page where a database block is, while the database is in the Trash (followed by a Restore button); {title} is the database's name; the Trash is the app's Trash, so use the same name the app gives it elsewhere
